## Christopher McLaren

I'm a bilingual financial engineer based in Montreal, Quebec, currently at **PSP Investments**,
one of Canada's largest Crown corporation pension investment managers.

My work sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, counterparty credit risk, and
derivatives — building models and tools that help understand and manage complex financial exposures.

Over the past several years I've developed a strong interest in applying machine learning
and data science to financial problems, which led me to earn several ML certifications
and experiment with tools like Python, Julia, and QuantLib.

This site is where I share what I'm learning and building.
